title: Oxidex
body: Oxidex hangs in scattered clouds in open water. A cloud is common near the surface and rare in the deep, and it seldom sits on top of another plume.

Oxidex Permease, embedded in the membrane, pulls it into the cell when the cloud is richer than a faint trace. Nitroxidex Reductase spends that store together with Nitrox and recharges three carrier for each pair. ATP synthase turns the charge into ATP. Feeding from a cloud leaves the same kind of scar a mineral plume does.
